msgs.text: Now commit — staging only my three files:

**P-15f2c2c4 is closed** (commit `b775d50`) — and with it, **the entire c2c derivation is complete**. The analytic `hunram`, which had been an unproved hypothesis threaded through the whole §6.3 Kummer ledger, is now fully derived with no new axiom.

## What landed (increment 2, `GQ2/UnramifiedBridge.lean`)

**§Descend** — `descendHom`/`descendHom_apply`: factor a hom through a surjection with kernel inclusion.

**§OddPart** — the odd-torsion machinery: `oddTorsion hab` (subgroup of odd-order elements, commutativity threaded as `hab` to match the Galois-side shape), `odd_card_oddTorsion` (Cauchy contrapositive), `isPGroup_quotient_oddTorsion` (`g^{2^a}` has odd order via the `ordProj`/`ordCompl` calculus).

**§TameKill** — `unit_dies_in_two_group`: any `ξ' : C →* Q` into a finite 2-group kills `ρ g` at a reciprocity-unit lift — `ξ'∘ρ = (ξ'∘c)∘B.tameF` by `hfac`, continuity free from discrete `C` (with a local ⊥-topology on the abstract `Q`, dodging any Krull-instance interference), then c2c3's factoring + orientation.

**§OddE** — `odd_e_inertiaField` (**std-3 exactly**): `⟨t⟩ ◁ C` (already proved in `Tame.zpowers_normal_of_tame`!), `IsGalois ℚ₂ F₀` via mathlib's `InfiniteGalois.normal_iff_isGalois` (the flagged plumbing risk — it just existed), `κ : C →* Gal(F₀/ℚ₂)` descended from `restrictHom`, abelianness via the cyclic `C⧸⟨t⟩` generator argument, the unit-image killed into `oddTorsion`, and c2c2's `card_unitImage_eq_e` converting to `Odd e_{F₀}`.

**§Finale** — **`hunram_involution`**, the c2c deliverable: from c2b's `(k, L, hkL, hindex)` + the frozen 6.17 data + `horient` + `hLfix`, it concludes the verbatim `hunram` shape that `hvanish_involution`/`lemma_6_16` consume. **`#print axioms` = std-3 + B13 exactly** — *leaner* than the predicted std-3 + {B5, B10′, B13} budget, because `R` and the orientation are parameters (B5/B10′ enter only when the consumer instantiates `R := localReciprocity` and discharges `horient` at the witness via `tameUnitOrientation_witness`).

Gates: sorry-free, `lake build` green (8659), **guard all-pass** (census 15).

## The c2c ledger, final

| Lane | Deliverable | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| half (A) | `hunram_of_uniformizer_norm_eq` | std-3 |
| c2c1 | `relE` kit + coset norms | std-3 |
| c2c2 | `card_unitImage_eq_e` | std-3 (parametric B5) |
| c2c3 | `nuT`-factoring + orientation + witness | std-3 / +{B5,B10′} at witness |
| **c2c4** | **`hunram_involution`** | **std-3 + B13** |

Three gotchas banked on the row for future sessions: the `set`-rewrites-argument-types shadowing trap (use `revert`/`generalize`/`intro`), the `κ t = 1` motive trap (rewrite the argument side, never `t` under `κ`'s type), and `Nat.not_dvd_ordCompl` taking namespace-`Prime`.

**What unblocks**: c2b/f2d can now feed `hunram_involution` into `hvanish_involution_of_deepClass` — the one cross-flag is that the moved `lemma_6_17_vanish` gains the single orientation hypothesis `TameUnitOrientation localReciprocity B.tameF` (the `hc`/`hV2` amendment precedent, P-20 flag), discharged at `boundaryMapsWitness`. I noticed a new `InvolutionVanish.lean` appearing in the tree mid-session — the c2b lane is already assembling on top of this.
